## History

As a boy, James visited Prince [Edward Island](../codex/places.md#edward-island) and kept house with his sister until her death three years before. To fulfill a promise made to his dying sister, he married [Emily](../character/emily.md) Scott and went on a fortnight-long wedding trip to St. John. The couple subsequently separated over a dispute regarding his parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md).

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P58](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0058), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P59](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0059), [v3 ch.Friend P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013)_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--james-a.md)

James A and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) are friendly neighbors who frequently talk and share food. After his wife unexpectedly arrives in the area, James invites [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) over to his house so he can explain the backstory of their past separation.
